adjudication_note: Adversarial review round 2. Two forms were absorbing senses that are concepts in their own right. `prêmio` matched one of seven occurrences against the definition I narrowed in amendment 3 — I applied to entity.distribution the rule that narrowing a definition converts previously uncatchable matches into false positives, and then failed to apply it to technical.premium in the same amendment. `capital` matched 23 times for `the capital available to be allocated by a manager` while roughly half are capital gains, listed-company status, interest on equity, capital structure or Basel capital. Registering those senses is the repair; `Morgan Stanley Capital International` is the compound-fragment class again and is blocked instead.

concepts.def: The extra return demanded for holding an instrument that is harder to sell.
The appreciation realised on disposal of an asset, a taxable event.
A distribution to shareholders treated as an expense of the paying company under Brazilian law.
The mix of debt and equity financing a company, read as its leverage.
The capital a financial institution must hold against its risks under prudential rules.
The exposure a class of shares may take that could require capital beyond its net assets, subject to regulatory limits.
A company whose shares are admitted to trading on an exchange.
Dividends per share divided by share price.
